visual.general_description: Two line graphs comparing control and MK-801 rats over time after injection for locomotor activity (a) and stereotyped behavior score (b).
visual.detailed_description: Panel a has a boxed title reading "Locomotor activity (counts/5 min)". The x-axis is titled "Time after injection (min)" with tick labels baseline, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 and 60. The y-axis has tick labels 0, 100, 200 and 300. A legend lists an open circle series labeled "control" drawn with a dashed line and a filled circle series labeled "MK-801" drawn with a solid line. Every plotted point carries a vertical error bar. The MK-801 series sits clearly above the control series at every post-injection time, rises right after baseline and then declines gradually toward the end, while the control series stays flat and low. Every plotted point carries a vertical error bar. The MK-801 series rises over the early time points, stays high through the middle of the time course and then declines at the last time points, remaining above the control series throughout; the control series stays flat and low.

visual.general_description: Two line graphs of locomotor activity (a) and stereotyped behavior score (b) in rats given MK-801 alone or with ketamine 10 or 50 mg/kg.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a has a boxed title reading "Locomotor activity (counts/5 min)". Every plotted point carries a vertical error bar. Every plotted point carries a vertical error bar. The MK-801 alone series lies below both ketamine series at most points, comes closest to them in the middle of the time course, and pulls away from them again toward the end; the two ketamine series stay close to each other and both rise quickly after baseline.
